record.field: SendSure: ask a vendor to confirm their payout address
{{ object.env.company.name }} will pay you in USDC: confirm your payout address
Sent from a vendor: the link where they prove the wallet SendSure will pay.

div.p: Our company pays your invoices in USDC with SendSure. Before the first payment, please confirm the wallet you want to be paid to:

a.style: background-color: #1f7a5a; padding: 10px 16px; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px;

div.p: You sign once with that wallet. It costs nothing and sends nothing. From then on we can pay only that address, and changing it later needs both your old and your new wallet. For each invoice we pay, you confirm the amount the same way. Keep this email: each invoice we send for payment shows up on the same link, for you to check and sign.
If you did not expect this email, reply to it before you open the link. It runs on Arc testnet today, with test USDC.

record.field: SendSure: ask a vendor to sign a bill
{{ object.company_id.name }}: please check and sign invoice {{ object.ref }} to be paid in USDC
Sent from a vendor bill sent with SendSure: the vendor's own link, where they check the bill and sign it.

div.p: We are paying your invoice INV-2026-041 for $ 1.50 in USDC with SendSure. Before we can pay it, please check the amount and sign it:

a.style: background-color: #1f7a5a; padding: 10px 16px; color: #ffffff; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 6px;

div.p: It is the same link you used to confirm your payout address. Signing costs nothing and sends nothing. Once it is signed, we pay it to the address you proved, and the payment shows on the same page. If something is wrong, choose "Not mine / wrong" there and tell us.
If you did not expect this email, reply to it before you open the link. It runs on Arc testnet today, with test USDC.
